description.vi: Mô hình ôn tập ngắt quãng Leitner 5 hộp: trả lời đúng thì thẻ lên hộp tiếp theo, trả lời sai thì về hộp 1.
description.en: Five-box Leitner spaced-repetition model: a correct answer moves the card up one box, a wrong answer sends it back to box 1.
description.ja: 5つの箱を使うライトナー式の間隔反復モデルです。正解するとカードは次の箱へ進み、不正解だと箱1に戻ります。
description.ru: Модель интервального повторения Лейтнера с пятью коробками: верный ответ переводит карточку в следующую коробку, неверный возвращает её в коробку 1.

rules.mastered: box 5 answered correctly 2 times in a row -> mastered = true and interval_days = 90
rules.leech: lapses >= 8 -> leech = true; the item is shown in a dedicated lesson and suspended for 7 days
rules.order: overdue first (oldest due date), then new items; shuffle inside the same due date
rules.same_day_retry: a wrong card is shown once more at the end of the session; this retry does not change the box

item_sources.ids: unit.srs_item_ids (words and dialogue lines, ids like ja_u01_w1 and ja_u01_l2)
item_sources.card_back: word.gloss or line.translation in the UI language
